draft.description: Complete or edit the job SWMS while it is in Draft. Save Draft to continue later, Submit to keep working, or Lock when ready for sign-off.

locked.description: This SWMS is locked. Return it for modification or start sign-off.

sign-off.description: Read and sign this SWMS, return it for modification, add signatories, or reassign.

complete.description: All required sign-offs are done. Complete the job to archive, or add more signatories.

messages.sign-off: Sign off this SWMS before it can be archived.
